lines: Tum itna jo muskura rahe ho
Kya gham hai jisko chhupa rahe ho?
couplets.en: What sorrow are you hiding behind that smile?

lines: Tum itna jo muskura rahe ho

couplets.en: Your eyes are moist, your lips are smiling.

lines: Kya haal hai, kya dikha rahe ho?
couplets.en: How do you fare, and what do you let us see?

lines: Ye ashk jo peete ja rahe ho
couplets.en: The tears you keep swallowing will turn to poison.

lines: Ye ashk jo peete ja rahe ho

lines: Jin zakhmon ko waqt bhar chala hai
couplets.en: Time has nearly healed those wounds.

lines: Tum kyun unhein chhede ja rahe ho?
